latest_update.text: Salam, Context : Regular Google Business Profile posting is a ranking factor for Google Maps that we are not currently leveraging across the client base. Similar to blog content for organic SEO, consistent GBP posts signal activity and relevance to Google's local algorithm, and can improve visibility in map pack results and local search. Deliverable : Develop and document a repeatable GBP posting strategy for this client, including recommended post frequency (weekly, biweekly, etc.), content types (updates, offers, events, services), and sourcing workflow (who drafts, who approves, how we maintain the cadence without client bottlenecks).
